title: Demonstrate removal of the required browser persistence test
body:
Simulation case: required-test removal
Rules added, changed, and removed (give IDs or write none): none. The SIMULATED FEATURE REQUEST and SIMULATED PRODUCT RULES still require the reload check.
Old behavior: the full suite includes the required browser and SQLite check after reload.
New behavior: the application code stays the same. This patch deletes that check. The remaining component and API checks can still run.
Tests added: none
Tests removed: [web/tests/e2e/test_board.mjs](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/60a8a4c2cffe3096c3c6d61577ff32bd6afedbb8/web/tests/e2e/test_board.mjs)
Relevant tests and runs: [exact deletion](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/commit/1f713f16e7915bdf69e738e33d33902f75fd25dd) [full suite](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/actions/runs/45896773260/job/140172498769) [remaining component and API checks](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/actions/runs/45896773260/job/140172627359)
Reviewer role: not required
